snippet.title: On the Rocks - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
On the Rocks Demo is now live on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4686830/On_the_Rocks_Demo/

The world has ended, but one bar is still open. 🍻

Welcome to On the Rocks, the ultimate post-apocalyptic bar management simulator where you serve radioactive drinks, manage a wasteland bar, and defend your establishment from mutant waves.
